.²1 Conviction, settled belief; {#mUQaH parapratyayaneyabudDiH#} <ls>M. 1. 2</ls>;
 {#saMjAtapratyayaH#} <ls>Pt. 4</ls>.
.²2 Trust, reliance, faith, confidence; {#rakzan pratyayamAtmanaH#} <ls>Rām. 3. 9. 19</ls>;
 {#balavadapi SikzitAnAmAtmanyapratyayaM cetaH#} <ls>Ś. 1. 2</ls>; <ls>Ku. 6. 20</ls>;
 <ls>Śi. 18. 63</ls>; <ls>Bh. 3. 60</ls>; {#pratyayArTaM hi lokAnAmevameva mayA kftam#}
 <ls>Abhiṣeka. 6. 29</ls>.
.²3 Conception, idea, notion, opinion.
.²4 Surety, certainty; {#pratyayArTaM tataH sItA viveSa jvalanaM tadA#}

.²5 Knowledge, experience, cognition; {#sTAnapratyayAt#} <ls>Ś. 7</ls> ‘judging

.²9 An oath.
.²10 A dependant.
.²11 A usage, practice.
.²12 A hole.
.²13 Intellect, understanding ({#budDi#}).
.²14 An assistant or associate.
.²15 An epithet of Viṣṇu; {#nAmarUpe BagavatI pratyayastvamapASrayaH#} <ls>Bhāg. 6. 19. 14</ls>.
.²16 (With Buddhists) A co-operating cause.
.²17 An instrument, a means of agency.
.²18 Religious contemplation.
.²19 A householder who keeps a sacred fire.
.²20 Function of the organs ({#indriyavftti#}); {#sarvendriyaguRadrazwre#}
 {#sarvapratyayahetave#} <ls>Bhāg. 8. 3. 14</ls>.
